title: School for Agents — Skill Manifest
description: OpenSkills-compatible skill manifest with embedded guardrails. Version 1.0.

skill_uuid.description: Stable UUID v4 identifier for this skill. Must not change across versions.

description.description: What this skill enables an agent to do, and what it prevents.

related_skills.description: UUIDs of related skills from this registry (OpenSkills cross-references).

source_curriculum.description: Path to the curriculum that teaches this skill, e.g. 'curricula/ethical-reasoning-101'.

source_scenarios.description: Paths to scenario files that evaluate this skill.

guardrails.description: The safety contract for this skill. Travels with the skill on import.

allowed.description: Explicit list of action types this skill permits.

forbidden.description: Hard-forbidden action types. Violations cause automatic failure.

hard_limits.description: Rules that cannot be reasoned around, overridden, or soft-instructed away.

rule.description: The full rule text. Written as a constraint, not an instruction.

dry_run_required.description: If true, the skill must produce structured dry-run output before any execution.

human_in_loop_tier.description: 1=act then notify, 2=confirm before acting, 3=human must initiate.

passing_score.description: Minimum score (0-100) required to be considered trained in this skill.

assessment_scenarios.description: Paths to scenario files used to assess this skill.
